references.text: Complementary parts of the same census showing the progressive fulfillment of God's promise of a great nation through each mother's contribution.
Connects the geography of Paddan-Aram to God's blessing and shows how fertility encompassed both the owner and the slave woman within Leah's household.
The qualitative list of names that makes up the quantitative summary in 46:15, emphasizing each son's individual significance in God's plan.
Highlights how God's blessing extended over all of Leah's household (including the slave woman), which explains the high count in 46:15.
Connects God's response to Leah's prayers (30:17) directly to the historical fertility that resulted in the count of 33 (46:15).
The direct parallel that, together with 46:15, shows the complete structure of Jacob's family under God's blessing.
